name: Hisaka Yuri
source: [url=/c54044]Tomoe's[/url] upperclassman who lives in a faculty with her [url=/c27035]little sister[/url] due to having lost her parents at a young age. Her daily routine consist of her going to pick up her sister from another school. Yuri doesn't have many friends due to thinking many things are better done alone than in a group.
